text: M13 irsmg4jn (2.1.88) scopes a plugin skill by the ContextType set of "the Host API version the plugin declared in its manifest", frozen there. A manifest does not declare a version, it declares a semver RANGE (`hostApiVersion: "^2.0.0"`). The spec does not say which version of the range is "the declared one", nor where each version's set is recorded. Built as: the declared version is the lowest version the range admits (`semver.minVersion`), its set is that of the latest Host API release at or below it, and every release in the Host API release registry records its set. A range below the oldest release gets the oldest set. Please state this reading in M13 (or M33's Host API versioning section) and name where a release's set is recorded.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:contribution-scope-declared-version: declared version = minVersion(hostApiVersion range); its set = the set of the latest release at or below it (HOST_API_RELEASES[].contextTypes).
